newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish share index poised to hit new record peak.
newsitem.headline: Danish share index poised to hit new record peak.

text.p: Danish share prices opened unchanged on Monday, with dealers predicting moderate gains ahead with the KFX index seen hitting another new record after Friday's Dow rise.
"We seem headed for a modest rise today just like Friday but gains won't be so major as they were in New York," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index was unaltered at 171.23 at 0720 GMT, having closed 0.47 point higher on Friday - the fourth all-time record closing high within one week. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969652
